basis.quote: I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area.
basis.interpretation: Current localized contact dermatitis from known exposure, consistent with poison ivy; rash is on forearms and spreading within that area, which is typical for early-stage contact dermatitis without systemic spread.
No reported fever or respiratory symptoms at present; breathing is normal currently.

basis.quote: What if my tongue swells later? It is not swollen now and my breathing is normal.
basis.interpretation: Patient is expressing concern about a hypothetical future complication (tongue swelling); actual tongue swelling and airway compromise are not currently present. Oral involvement in simple poison ivy is uncommon without direct contact to the mouth.

output.reason: Localized contact dermatitis without systemic features, airway compromise or oral involvement; self-care management with topical treatment and monitoring is appropriate.
